fullTextHeadings.9: Your role in keeping GitLab team members engaged & informed

paragraphs: 🤝 Provide context, reason, and a call to action.
🤝 Give feedback effectively and assume positive intent: Collaborating asynchrounously can require a few back and forths before there’s alignment, that’s expected.
👣 Set a due date and embrace iteration: Understanding when something is needed or if there’s a different priority for a given piece of work helps us to prioritize.
👁 Say why, not just what: Whether giving feedback or briefing in a need, add as much “why” as possible.
translations: 提供背景、原因和明确的行动要求。
尊重大家的时间和注意力。
有效地提出反馈，并假设对方出于善意。异步协作可能需要几轮沟通才能达成一致，这是正常的。
设定截止日期，并接受反复修改。说明内容何时需要、优先级是否变化，有助于团队安排工作。
说清为什么，而不只是说发生了什么。无论是反馈还是需求说明，都应尽可能补充原因。
fullTextParagraphs: “Internal communication” is the connective tissue that keeps everything and everyone in the company moving forward in the same direction. It’s a broad term and is an aspect of our culture that every team contributes to in some form.

The People Communications & Engagement team aims to keep team members informed and engaged through compelling internal storytelling and timely information sharing to empower team members to become GitLab ambassadors.
This page defines how our People Communications & Engagement team operates to support GitLab team members and various cross-functional teams within GitLab.
👁 Be credible, transparent, open, and honest
🤝 Provide context, reason, and a call to action.
📈 Be consistent on delivery, cadence, and tone.
Your role in keeping GitLab team members engaged & informed
Everyone plays a role in keeping GitLab team members engaged and informed. If you’re partnering with the People Communications & Engagement team, please keep these best practices in mind:

📈 Take ownership of your subject matter expertise: If you’re requesting something be communicated to team members, it’s likely that your expertise on the change will be key, sharing as much as possible about a given change will be helpful.
🤝 Give feedback effectively and assume positive intent: Collaborating asynchrounously can require a few back and forths before there’s alignment, that’s expected.
👣 Set a due date and embrace iteration: Understanding when something is needed or if there’s a different priority for a given piece of work helps us to prioritize.
👁 Say why, not just what: Whether giving feedback or briefing in a need, add as much “why” as possible.
verifiedFacts: GitLab 员工沟通手册要求内部信息提供背景、原因和行动要求。
手册强调尊重员工的时间，并在重要沟通中说明“为什么”。
跨团队协作时可以设定反馈期限，并根据反馈修改文案。

scenario.title: 虚构情境：通知新的请假申请流程
english: The leave-request process will change on January 15 so employees can plan time off more easily.
Write a short message to the whole team, explain why the process is changing, and ask everyone to review the updated steps.
chinese: 请假申请流程将于 1 月 15 日调整，让员工更方便地安排休假。
请给团队写一条简短通知，说明调整原因，并请大家查看更新后的步骤。

firstAttempt.prompt: 差旅报销流程将从 12 月 1 日起调整，目的是让员工更方便地提交申请。请给内部沟通同事写一条英文消息：说明背景和原因，请对方确认合适的发布渠道，并在 11 月 20 日前反馈。
firstAttempt.sample: Hi team, we’re updating the travel-expense process starting December 1 so employees can submit claims more easily. Could you confirm the best channel for sharing the update? If possible, please send your feedback by November 20. I’m happy to revise the draft based on your suggestions.
firstAttempt.rationale: 消息交代了变化、原因、需要对方做什么和反馈期限。

structure.original: 🤝 Provide context, reason, and a call to action.
analysis: provide context 是“补充背景”，reason 是“说明原因”。
and 连接两个并列的信息要求。
a call to action 指读者看完后要采取的具体行动。
structure.transfer: Please provide context, explain why the date is changing, and tell the team what to do next.

rewrite.bad: The expense process is changing soon. Please check the handbook.
rewrite.good: We’re updating the travel-expense process starting December 1 so employees can submit claims more easily. Please review the new steps in the handbook by November 20.

rewrite.pattern: We’re changing ... so ... . Please + 行动 + by + 截止日期.
